_README: === YOUR IMAGE/GIF/VIDEO LINKS (my_links.json) — v2.8.4 (HOT-RELOADED) — PREMIUM HD ADULT SITES ONLY ===
_HOW_TO: PUT any website link in a slot's 'url'. Four kinds work:
1. Bare domain:  https://example.com  -> page fetched directly
3. Template:     https://example.com/search?q={query} -> {query} is replaced by the search word.
'type': 'image', 'gif', or 'video'. 'enabled': false switches a slot off without deleting it.
v2.5 HOT-RELOAD: edit this file and the NEXT search already uses it — NO restart needed.
v2.5 YOUR LINKS ARE TRIED FIRST and their results LEAD the list (the bot downloads images[0]).
CHECK /my-links in a browser — per-slot diagnostics: lastResult {count, error, ts}.
A dead slot never breaks a search — it is skipped, logged, and shown in the diagnostics.
v2.8.4: Premium HD sites only. Booru/generic sources removed. All slots user-defined or disabled.
